RJ Barrett led the Raptors with 27 points (11-18 FG, 2-5 3PT), 4 rebounds and 4 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, ball security, second chances. Effective FG% 57.6 to 51.6.
Biggest swing: Scottie Barnes technical foul (Q1 11:43), +3 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Mitchell, Strus, Allen, Garland, Mobley, +19 in 9:51.
Bench points: CLE 56, TOR 40. Points in the paint: 60–60. Second-chance points: 12–11.
